responsibility: This module implements the GCC Rust frontend’s HIR type-checking subsystem: it defines the internal TyTy type model and type-checking context, resolves HIR items, types, expressions, statements, patterns, paths, and impl members into that model, and enforces Rust type rules before later lowering. Its major file families cover the crate-wide and staged HIR checking passes (top-level seeding, item/type/expr/stmt/pattern checking, enum and struct construction, impl and trait-item validation), trait and associated-item machinery (trait reference building, trait-path resolution, bound probing, path probing, dot-operator and method lookup, inherent-impl overlap checking), and the core semantic operations on resolved types such as unification, coercions, explicit casts, autoderef/autoref adjustments, call checking, generic substitution, variance analysis, and lazy type queries. Together these components provide Rust-specific typing, inference, trait-bound satisfaction, associated-type handling, adjustment recording, diagnostics, and context management that distinguish this directory from parsing, name resolution, or backend lowering modules.
